# RLArenaCollisionDumper (third-party, MIT)

`RLArenaCollisionDumper.exe` is the unmodified v1.0.0 release asset of
[ZealanL/RLArenaCollisionDumper](https://github.com/ZealanL/RLArenaCollisionDumper/releases/tag/v1.0.0)
(66,048 bytes, SHA-256 `91a40fc8d705a4c44b692c534f826253cf7b60b34bfacd4b90c6f6029875e5c5`), under the MIT License
in [LICENSE](LICENSE). It stays under that license; the rest of this repository is AGPL-3.0.

On Windows, when the bot finds no collision meshes, `chadgpt/mesh_dump.py` runs it once against the running
Rocket League to write the 16 soccar meshes that the shadow arena loads into RocketSim. The meshes are Rocket
League's data and are not part of this repository.
